description:
Holder votes on a game's questions, each wallet weighed by the game's
    coin it held when the question was posted (staked coin included). No
    ballot: a game's ballots (`game`, e.g. 'gates'; `wallet` adds what yours
    may do). ballot: one in full — the tally, every signed vote, the
    snapshot, the signed result once closed. ballot + wallet + choice:
    unsigned, the text to sign and its at; signed (at + signature), your vote.
    Our wallets and a game's developer never vote. Recount any result with
    meter/vote_recount.py.
name: votes
